description: This file defines the TaxRate model class for the OpenCart admin system, handling CRUD operations for tax rate records including related customer group associations in the database.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Model class for managing tax rate data, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving tax rates, and managing associations with customer groups.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Creates a new tax rate record in the database, optionally associating it with customer groups.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate record and its customer group associations.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Deletes a tax rate record and its related customer group associations.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific tax rate.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Gets tax rates associated with a specific geographical zone.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rate records.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Returns count of tax rates within a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a specific tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specific customer group from tax rates.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves customer groups associated with a specific tax rate.
